title: Performance
description: Practices for reasoning about and preserving performance.

practices.title: Measure first
practices.statement: Require measurement or clear complexity reasoning before accepting a performance claim.

practices.title: Hot path budget
practices.statement: Keep allocation and copying off identified hot paths.

practices.title: Caches are their invalidation
practices.statement: A cache is correct only if its invalidation is; unbounded caches are leaks.

practices.title: Batch small I/O
practices.statement: Batch small I/O operations instead of rounding per item.
